## Type of change

<!-- Check the box that applies. Multiple OK. -->

- [ ] Typo / grammar / link repair
- [ ] Fact correction (cite the source in the summary)
- [ ] New paper summary
- [ ] New or refreshed explainer
- [ ] Guide page (learn, work, build, tools, safety, careers)
- [ ] Automation / CI / scripts
- [ ] Other (describe in summary)

## Out-of-scope check

- [ ] No marketing / affiliate / SEO content
- [ ] No verbatim vendor exam questions

## House style

- [ ] No em dashes; only regular dashes (`-`)
- [ ] Written for a motivated beginner; jargon explained on first use
- [ ] Numbers, dates and author lists checked against the real source
- [ ] Moving facts dated ("as of ...") and sourced

## Checks

If you ran them, paste the summary lines here:

- [ ] `python3 scripts/build_manifest.py` (commit what it changes)
- [ ] `python3 scripts/check_links.py` clean
- [ ] `python3 scripts/check_counts.py` clean
